# Payments & Stripe

This document covers the full payment system: Stripe integration, webhook handling, database schema, access control, plan switching, and all related functions/hooks.

## Architecture Overview

```
Stripe Dashboard ──► Webhooks ──► Better Auth Plugin ──► DB (products, orders, subscriptions)
                                                              │
User ──► tRPC Procedures ──► Stripe SDK ──────────────────────┘
                │
          React Hooks ──► UI Components
```

## Plan Registry

**File:** `config/plans.ts` (auto-generated by `pnpm sync:plans`)

Maps human-readable plan names to Stripe price IDs. Fully type-safe — `PlanKey` and `ProductKey` types provide autocomplete.

```ts
import { plans, oneTimeProducts } from "@/config/plans";

plans.basic.priceId;           // "price_xxx"
oneTimeProducts.book.priceId;  // "price_yyy"
```

**Sync script:** `scripts/sync-plans.ts` — fetches all active Stripe products, splits by recurring/one-time, sorts by price, writes `config/plans.ts`. Runs automatically in `prebuild`.

## Access Control

**Hook:** `services/auth/hooks/use-access.ts`

Wraps `useGetCustomerState()` with typed helpers:

| Method | Params | Purpose |
|--------|--------|---------|
| `hasPlan(key)` | `PlanKey` | Exact plan match |
| `hasPlanOrHigher(key)` | `PlanKey` | Plan or higher tier (key order = price order) |
| `hasPlanByPriceId(priceId)` | `string` | Plan match for dynamic iteration |
| `hasProduct(key)` | `ProductKey` | One-time purchase check |
| `hasProductByPriceId(priceId)` | `string` | Purchase check for dynamic iteration |
| `hasSubscription` | — | Has any active subscription |
| `activeSubscription` | — | Subscription object or null |
| `getPlanPriceId(key)` | `PlanKey` | Price ID for a plan |
| `getPlanName(key)` | `PlanKey` | Display name for a plan |

**Usage:**

```tsx
const { hasPlan, hasProduct, hasPlanOrHigher } = useAccess();

if (hasPlan("pro")) { /* exact match */ }
if (hasPlanOrHigher("basic")) { /* basic or above */ }
if (hasProduct("book")) { /* purchased book */ }
```

## Database Tables

**File:** `services/db/schema.ts`

### `products` — local mirror of Stripe products (synced via webhooks)

| Column | Type | Purpose |
|--------|------|---------|
| `id` | text (PK) | Stripe product ID (`prod_xxx`) |
| `name` | text | Product name |
| `description` | text | Product description |
| `priceId` | text | Stripe price ID (`price_xxx`) |
| `priceAmount` | integer | Price in cents |
| `priceCurrency` | text | Currency code |
| `recurringInterval` | text | day/week/month/year |
| `isRecurring` | boolean | Subscription vs one-time |
| `isArchived` | boolean | Soft delete |
| `metadata` | jsonb | Custom metadata from Stripe |

### `subscription` — synced from Stripe subscription webhooks

| Column | Type | Purpose |
|--------|------|---------|
| `id` | text (PK) | Internal ID |
| `plan` | text | Price ID (used for access checks) |
| `referenceId` | text | User ID |
| `stripeSubscriptionId` | text | Stripe subscription ID |
| `status` | text | active/canceled/trialing/past_due/etc. |
| `periodStart/End` | timestamp | Current billing period |
| `cancelAtPeriodEnd` | boolean | Canceling at period end |
| `totalAmount` | integer | Amount in cents |
| `billingInterval` | text | month/year |
| `metadata` | jsonb | Merged subscription + product metadata |

### `orders` — one-time purchase records

| Column | Type | Purpose |
|--------|------|---------|
| `id` | text (PK) | PaymentIntent ID (`pi_xxx`) |
| `userId` | text (FK) | User reference |
| `productId` | text | Stripe product ID |
| `priceId` | text | Stripe price ID |
| `amount` | integer | Total in cents |
| `status` | text | pending/paid/refunded/partially_refunded/void |
| `receiptUrl` | text | Stripe receipt URL |
| `metadata` | jsonb | Session + product metadata |

### `webhookEvents` — audit trail

| Column | Type | Purpose |
|--------|------|---------|
| `id` | text (PK) | UUID |
| `type` | text | Event type |
| `payload` | jsonb | Full event payload |

## Webhook Flow

**File:** `services/auth/auth.ts` (Stripe plugin `onEvent` handler)

| Stripe Event | Handler | File |
|-------------|---------|------|
| `product.created/updated/deleted` | `createProduct/updateProduct/deleteProduct` | `services/auth/actions/products.ts` |
| `checkout.session.completed` | `completeCheckout` | `services/auth/actions/checkout.ts` |
| `checkout.session.async_payment_succeeded` | `confirmAsyncPayment` | `services/auth/actions/checkout.ts` |
| `checkout.session.async_payment_failed` | `failAsyncPayment` | `services/auth/actions/checkout.ts` |
| `customer.subscription.created` | `createSubscription` | `services/auth/actions/subscriptions.ts` |
| `customer.subscription.updated` | `updateSubscription` | `services/auth/actions/subscriptions.ts` |
| `customer.subscription.deleted` | `deleteSubscription` | `services/auth/actions/subscriptions.ts` |
| `charge.refunded` | `processRefund` | `services/auth/actions/refunds.ts` |

### Checkout flow

1. `completeCheckout(session)` — extracts payment intent, customer, line items
2. Finds user by `stripeCustomerId`
3. Fetches receipt URL from latest charge
4. Inserts into `orders` table with `session.metadata` (product metadata passed at checkout creation)

### Subscription flow

1. `buildSubscriptionValues(sub, userId)` — normalizes Stripe subscription object
2. Extracts plan (price lookup_key or price ID), period dates, amounts
3. Merges product metadata from local DB
4. Inserts/updates `subscription` table

## Stripe Payment Functions

**File:** `services/payments/client.ts`

| Function | Purpose |
|----------|---------|
| `createCustomer(input)` | Creates Stripe customer with email, name, metadata |
| `deleteCustomer(customerId)` | Deletes Stripe customer |
| `createCheckoutSession(input)` | Creates checkout session with line items, URLs, metadata |
| `retrieveCheckoutSession(sessionId)` | Fetches session status |
| `createPortalSession(input)` | Creates billing portal for self-service |
| `getSubscriptionDetails(subscriptionId)` | Fetches live subscription data + scheduled plan changes |
| `switchPlan(input)` | Upgrades or downgrades subscription plan |
| `listPromotionCodes(options?)` | Lists active promotion codes |

### Checkout session metadata

Product metadata is attached at checkout creation time (`billing.createCheckout` mutation), not fetched separately in the webhook. This avoids an extra DB query on checkout completion.

## Plan Switching

**File:** `services/payments/client.ts` — `switchPlan()`

### Upgrade (`immediate: true` or omitted)

- Applies immediately via `stripe.subscriptions.update`
- Uses `proration_behavior: "always_invoice"` — charges the prorated difference as a separate invoice right away
- User gets instant access to the new plan

### Downgrade (`immediate: false`)

- Creates a Stripe subscription schedule
- Current plan stays active until period end
- New (lower) plan starts at the next billing cycle
- If a schedule already exists, updates the upcoming phase

### Scheduled change visibility

`getSubscriptionDetails()` expands the subscription's schedule and checks for upcoming phases. If a different price is scheduled, it returns `scheduledChange` with the new plan name and effective date. The settings UI shows this as an amber banner.

## tRPC Procedures

**File:** `services/trpc/routers/billing.ts`

All procedures use `authenticatedProcedure.use(featureGuard("payments"))`.

| Procedure | Type | Purpose |
|-----------|------|---------|
| `getCustomerState` | Query | Returns subscriptions, paidOrders, activeSubscription, currentPlan, isUserHaveAccess |
| `listSubscriptions` | Query | Lists user's subscriptions with product names (joined from products table) |
| `listOrders` | Query | Merges one-time orders from DB + subscription invoices from Stripe API |
| `verifyCheckout` | Query | Validates checkout session completion |
| `createCheckout` | Mutation | Creates customer if needed, determines mode, creates checkout session |
| `createPortalSession` | Mutation | Creates Stripe billing portal link |
| `switchPlan` | Mutation | Validates ownership, rejects canceled subs, delegates to `switchPlan()` |
| `getSubscriptionDetails` | Query | Fetches live subscription + scheduled changes from Stripe |
| `deleteCustomer` | Mutation | Deletes Stripe customer and DB user |

**File:** `services/trpc/routers/products.ts`

| Procedure | Type | Access | Purpose |
|-----------|------|--------|---------|
| `list` | Query | public | Lists non-archived products sorted by price |
| `listAll` | Query | admin | Lists all products |
| `update` | Mutation | admin | Updates product details |
| `delete` | Mutation | admin | Deletes product |

## React Hooks

**File:** `services/auth/hooks/use-payments.ts`

| Hook | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `useGetCustomerState()` | Fetches subscription + order state for current user |
| `useCheckout()` | Initiates checkout, redirects to Stripe (redirects to signup if unauthorized) |
| `useSwitchPlan()` | Switches plan, shows toast, revalidates after 2s delay (webhook sync) |
| `useSubscriptionDetails(id)` | Fetches live subscription details (enabled when ID exists) |
| `useGeneratePortalLink()` | Creates billing portal session, redirects user |

## UI Pages & Components

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `app/(marketing)/features/page.tsx` | Feature-gated demo page: subscription plans + one-time purchases from DB |
| `app/checkout/page.tsx` | Checkout redirect: extracts priceIds from URL, calls `useCheckout()` |
| `app/success/page.tsx` | Post-payment confirmation: verifies checkout session |
| `components/settings/billing/subscriptions.tsx` | Subscription table with expandable details + scheduled change banner |
| `components/settings/billing/invoices.tsx` | Payment history: one-time orders + subscription invoices |

## Key Flows

### User signs up
1. Better Auth creates user
2. Stripe plugin `createCustomerOnSignUp: true` creates Stripe customer
3. `user.stripeCustomerId` stored in DB

### User subscribes
1. `/features` or `/checkout` → `useCheckout({ priceIds })` → `billing.createCheckout`
2. Product metadata attached to session at creation time
3. Stripe checkout → payment → webhook `checkout.session.completed` / `customer.subscription.created`
4. Order/subscription inserted in DB

### User upgrades
1. `/features` → "Upgrade to Pro" button → `useSwitchPlan({ immediate: true })`
2. `switchPlan()` → `stripe.subscriptions.update` with `always_invoice`
3. Stripe charges prorated difference immediately
4. Webhook `customer.subscription.updated` → DB synced
5. UI revalidates after 2s

### User downgrades
1. `/features` → "Downgrade to Basic" button → `useSwitchPlan({ immediate: false })`
2. `switchPlan()` → creates subscription schedule
3. Current plan stays active until period end
4. Settings shows "Scheduled plan change" banner
5. At period end, Stripe automatically switches plan

### User purchases one-time product
1. `/features` → "Purchase Book" → `useCheckout({ priceIds })`
2. Stripe checkout → payment → webhook `checkout.session.completed`
3. Order inserted in DB
4. `useAccess().hasProduct("book")` returns true
